about: Taste notes the agent uses to score events (0-100). Top-level likes/lessLikely are Ian (first person); Emily is under people.emily. Shared household likes appear in both. Flags on the calendar are learned on top of this.

family.rule: Include family-friendly / kid-friendly events EVERY day of the week (kids-only programming is OK) alongside the usual adult events. Tag every one of them "family" so the calendar's Kids events toggle can hide or show them.
family.ageNote: Kids are 4 and 10. Prefer events that work for both ages together (zoo, COSI, parks, festivals, family concerts, library programs); toddler-only or teen-only events score lower.
family.sportsNote: The 10-year-old daughter is interested in women's sports: Columbus Fury (pro volleyball), Ohio State women's basketball, volleyball, hockey and soccer, and other women's games in reach. Tag these family + womens-sports.
